checks.what: +5V_GPIB falls when the bus is switched off (Q1 opens)
+1V1 ripple (a scope's figure, rev A's substituted L1)

notes: Hand meter, black lead on J1's shell (Jason, 2026-11-18). TP1-TP4 first with A1 parked (bus off), then TP4 and TP1 with the bus on (green LED lit).
VBUS fell 43 mV when the transceivers came on (5.202 to 5.159 V, through a hub three levels deep); Q1 drops 15 mV (5.159 to 5.144 V).
TP4 at 0 V with the bus off: R21 (the SN75161B's DC pull-up) does not back-power +5V_GPIB (PIN_AUDIT.md's uncertain item).

+1V1 by scope (results/2026-11-18/113626_scope_1V1_A1.json): 1.107 V bus on, 1.100 V off. Ripple bus on / off: 14.8 / 12.5 mV pp at 200 ns/div; 44.3 / 45.3 mV pp, 2.5 mV rms at 20 us/div; 48.3 / 46.3 mV pp at 1 ms/div. The same with the transceivers on or off; the pp is mostly spikes picked up by a hand-held probe at full bandwidth.
The 3.3 V rail by meter, 3.308 V, against stage 1's 3.24 V from the temperature sensor at an assumed 40 C die: the die was nearer 32 C.
